content: दस्युः [दस्-युच्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a class of evil beings or demons, enemies of gods and men, and slain by Indra, (mostly Vedic in this sense). .²2 An outcast, a Hindu who has become an outcast by neglect of the essential rites; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 5. 131</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">10. 45</ls>; दस्यूनां दीयतामेष साध्वद्य पुरुषाधमः <ls>Mb. 12. 173. 20</ls>. .²3 A thief, robber, bandit; नीत्वोत्पथं विषयदस्युषु निक्षिपन्ति <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 46</ls>; पात्रीकृतो दस्युरिवासि येन <ls>Ś. 5. 20</ls>; <ls>R. 9. 53</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7 143</ls>. .²4 A villain, miscreant; दस्योरस्य कृपाणपातविषयादाच्छिन्दतः प्रेयसीम् <ls>Māl. 5. 28</ls>. .²5 A desperado, violator, oppressor.
